subject: Security acceptance sprint and decision lane — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA milestones
messages:
From: Ari Goldstein <ari.goldstein@crestbank.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: claire.mendez@crestbank.com
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial intake — security checkpoints and timeline

Markus,

Thanks for the intake call earlier. Claire and I sketched a tentative MAP internally and wanted to confirm a practical acceptance runway from Redwood. High-level asks from CrestBank security/compliance: 

- SOC 2 Type II evidence walkthrough (control mapping + recent report)
- Completion of SIG/CAIQ questionnaire (we can provide our spreadsheet)
- Standard DPA with data retention window: we prefer 90 days for cache/ephemeral logs but need examples of retention tiers and escrow options
- Proof of key management (KMS/HSM) and EU residency options (if needed later)

We'd like to agree milestones and a date to move from evaluation (POC) to production (early access). Do you have a canonical MAP template you use for bank-grade customers?

Also looping your SOC contact if needed — cc'd is Claire (security ops).

Thanks,
Ari

-- 
Ari Goldstein
Head of Security Engineering, CrestBank
ari.goldstein@crestbank.com
+1 415-555-0199

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Ari Goldstein <ari.goldstein@crestbank.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 13:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Initial intake — security checkpoints and timeline

Ari — thanks for the clear list. Short answer: yes, we can support that runway. Proposed high-level MAP (draft):

1) Week 0 (kickoff): Sign NDA + intake SIG/CAIQ spreadsheet, assign evidence owners
2) Week 1–2: Provide SOC 2 Type II summary + control mapping doc; schedule live walkthrough with our security SME
3) Week 2–4: Complete SIG/CAIQ Q&A (we'll upload answers into your spreadsheet); begin DPA redline cycle
4) Week 3–5: POC security tests, prefix/KV caching retention options — decide retention tier (30/90/180)
5) Week 5: Finalize DPA and DocuSign; early access provisioning (private tenant)

Action items for us: upload SOC 2 summary, provide public SIG/CAIQ baseline, and share a DPA template with suggested retention language.

Questions for you: is CrestBank comfortable with the 90-day default for ephemeral logs, and do you need any additional EU residency commitments now or just capability notes?

I've attached a draft MAP-acceptance-timeline.pdf and a placeholder SIG/CAIQ spreadsheet (crestbank-sig-caiq.xlsx). Kimberly — can you pick up the DPA redline? Naomi — please prep the SOC 2 summary and control mapping.

I'll block 30 minutes this Thursday for the walkthrough unless that conflicts with your calendar.

Best,
Markus Klein
VP, Sales — Enterprise, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
--
Attachment stubs: MAP-acceptance-timeline.pdf (PDF), crestbank-sig-caiq.xlsx (Excel)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial intake — security checkpoints and timeline

Markus / team — taking DPA redlines. Quick notes from legal & privacy: 

- Retention: we can offer three standard tiers to choose from and bake the selection into the SOW: 30 days (default for session/caching), 90 days (recommended for financial customers), 180 days (requires additional escrow/archival terms). We'll call out deletion semantics (logical deletion vs physical) and SLA for purge.
- Data residency: we can include capability clauses for EU residency and an explicit timeline for enabling regions (30–45 days after sign).
- KMS: we support both Redwood-managed KMS and customer-managed keys; for CrestBank, customer-managed keys via AWS KMS or Azure Key Vault + HSM attestations is the cleanest path.

I'm attaching our DPA redlines (redlines-DPA-CrestBank.docx). I'll highlight the retention language we propose and a minimal carveout for legal discovery. Ben — can you surface the cost delta for 90 vs 30 day retention (storage + snapshotting) so sales can model the commit?

I'll be online for the walkthrough on Thursday; Naomi, can you confirm SOC 2 doc readiness?

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
--
Attachment stubs: redlines-DPA-CrestBank.docx (Word)

From: Claire Mendez <claire.mendez@crestbank.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: Ari Goldstein <ari.goldstein@crestbank.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 11:06:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Initial intake — security checkpoints and timeline

Markus / team — thanks, this looks good. A few clarifications from CrestBank Ops: 

1) Retention — we prefer 90 days for cached prompts & KV, 30 days for ephemeral debug logs. We need an SLA for purge (max 7 days after request) and visibility to purge jobs via audit logs.
2) DPA — we'll send a redline with a narrow exception for lawful disclosure; otherwise the DPA template is fine. Please also include a DocuSign link when ready.
3) SIG/CAIQ — attached is our completed spreadsheet; can Redwood return answers inline? (we prefer a pulled spreadsheet back rather than a shared doc edit).

Final ask: can we lock a tentative go/no-go milestone on July 16 — that gives our security team three weeks after the walkthrough to validate artifacts. If Redwood can commit to the MAP above and provide the SOC 2 summary by EOD Thursday, we'll proceed.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Mendez
Security Operations Manager, CrestBank
claire.mendez@crestbank.com
--
Attachment stubs: crestbank-sig-caiq-complete.xlsx (Excel)

Claire — perfect, appreciate the clarity. Confirming next steps and committed milestones so everyone's aligned: 

- Thu 25 Jun (EOD): Redwood provides SOC 2 summary + control mapping (naomi_feldman). Shared to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bC3MAP-evidence
- Fri 26 Jun: Redwood returns SIG/CAIQ answers inline to your spreadsheet (we'll upload crestbank-sig-caiq-answers.xlsx)
- Mon 29 Jun: Kimberly sends DPA redlines back to Claire (redlines-DPA-CrestBank.docx). We'll also put the DPA in DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/templates/DPA-CrestBank-2026
- Thu 16 Jul: Target go/no-go milestone — CrestBank final validation window closes that day

Retention choices confirmed: Redwood recommends 90 days for KV/prefix caching (recommended default) + 30 days for ephemeral logs. We'll include a 7-day purge SLA and audit-log exposure for purge events in the SOW. Cost delta note (Ben): expect ~12% incremental storage & snapshot overhead for 90 vs 30-day retention for caching tiers; Ben will follow up with exact pricing.

I'll attach the MAP-acceptance-timeline.pdf we discussed and open a HubSpot deal stage (link below). If that looks good, I'll schedule the SOC 2 walkthrough for Friday morning (30 minutes).

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/000654-C-2026-0654

Thanks all — we'll treat this as the decision lane and work to keep milestones tight.

Best,
Markus
